name: Yatsufusa
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "March of the Dead", Yatsufusa is an incredibly durable sharp katana Teigu that raises up to 8 corpses as puppets retaining their skills, abilities, and habits, but unable to grow stronger or learn. Each corpse drains part of your strength, returned when buried. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and Yatsufusa demands a macabre mindset.
